vix_spike_20.name: VIX spike above 20 (first close above 20, 10+ sessions since the last)

vix_spike_23.name: VIX spike above 23 (first close above 23, 10+ sessions since the last)

vix_at_or_over_20.name: Any evening with the VIX at 20 or more

vix_top_decile_of_its_year.name: VIX in the top tenth of its own past year (an extreme, read contrarian)

credit_under_200.name: Credit (HYG with payouts added back) under its 200-day

ten_short_stretched_high.name: 10-year, short clock: the yield's RSI in the top fifth of its own year (stretched high)

ten_short_washed_out.name: 10-year, short clock: the yield's RSI in the bottom fifth of its own year (washed out)

ten_long_above_200.name: 10-year, long clock: the yield above its 200-day

extreme_TLT.name: Long bonds (TLT) RSI in the top tenth of its year — a rush into bonds

extreme_GCUSD.name: Gold RSI in the top tenth of its year — a rush into gold

extreme_CLUSD.name: Oil RSI in the bottom tenth of its year — oil dumped

extreme_two_or_more.name: Two or more fear extremes at once (VIX, long bonds, gold, oil — each at its own one-year extreme)

trend.method: PELT, continuous piecewise-linear cost on the log close (ruptures)

moves_character.method: PELT, kernel (rbf) cost on daily log moves

vix20.label: the case began with the VIX at 20 or more

credit_under.label: the case began with credit under its 200-day

bunched.label: the 50-day and 100-day were within 3% of each other

lagging_leader.label: the sector fund was within 3% of its high and the stock was lagging it

fund_off_high_lagging.label: the sector fund was 3% or more off its high and the stock was lagging it

fund_near_high.label: the sector fund was within 3% of its high

bunched_dd.label: bunched: the deepest dip inside 20 sessions
